horoscopes.horoscope: Career decisions and money matters will keep you busy today. And after all the work, you will want to spend some leisure time and take it easy. A leisure trip may materialise, which will put you in high spirits. Ganesha says indulging in group projects will help you make new friends. You may remain very enthusiastic and will enjoy a fun-filled evening with your near and dear ones. Your cheerful spirit will attract your sweetheart. You will bring a smile on your partner’s face. In short, a positive day lies ahead for you. Today, you will remain in very good health. Your suggestions will help others and that will make you feel very good. As you will be in good mood and health, you will be able to complete many tasks that too very nicely. Ganesha feels that today you are going to remain very lucky for money matters. The day is such that if you want, you can mint money. This is an ideal day to launch your big projects. You will experience a phase of good luck today, feels Ganesha. You will try to begin work on new projects. The work will see a smooth progress post lunch. You are likely to share your opinions in the meeting. Your suggestions will be of great value to friends and colleagues.

You will win the heart of your family members today, forecasts Ganesha. Try and delay auction bids or sealed tenders. Job aspirants may look forward to belated success in interviews. Ganesha advises you to take abundant precautions in all critical matters. Personal life may remain almost uneventful, says Ganesha. You are likely to stay aloof. Your partner may raise the questions about being detached. Domestic routines may bore you. Singles are expected to spend the time alone. Committed couples may plan to bring excitement for the next day. Ganesha feels that it’s going to be very stressful day for you. Health wise, because this is not a good day, you will not be able to complete tasks on hand. You should not waste your time in useless things and should set your priority. The day doesn’t look good to Ganesha for your finances. You are likely to face problems on the financial front. You will feel that if you don’t find desired support from others, you may go bankrupt. You seem to be in a slightly different mood today. You may not wish to take up anything that you may not be able to handle. Equanimity will be seen in your actions. Professional work may seem slightly boring unless you explore new possibilities.

Your business rivals may compete with you in sales and deals today, warns Ganesha. Care and concern must be the two watchwords in all your dealings. Hostility may come in the way of love. Those spurned in previous romantic liaisons may get a chance to pen a new love story, says Ganesha. You will want to focus on your partner’s desires and expectations. Adjustment is the key to maintaining a balance in your relationship. Things will go smoothly once you will understand your partner. You may want to create excitement but you will remain indecisive, feels Ganesha. You may get more and more involved in matters related to other people. However, you should not allow this to happen. You should use your communication skills to resolve these matters. At the same time, don’t speak very much as it could drain you. Ganesha suggest you not to let any opportunity go waste. Be serious because money is likely to come in today. Distant possibility of gains through business partner or life partner is foreseen. You may lack efficiency in your profession. Your senior authorities will not care about your efficiency. However, they will want effectiveness from you. You need to ensure both, suggests Ganesha. You have to keep a low profile for the day if you attend any meeting.

Today, you may have to do a lot of multi-tasking at work, predicts Ganesha. And you are likely to do it with the dexterity of a juggler. You will finish your pending tasks with ease. You will make seemingly impossible tasks look as simple as blinking. You will do it all without even batting an eyelid. As you are provided with a lot of responsibilities in the workplace, you may not be able to give much time to near and dear ones, feels Ganesha. Things will be comfortable once you are able to communicate with your sweetheart even in the difficult situation. It’s not a very good day from health point of view, feels Ganesha. You could get fever or cold. However, you should be flexible with people and situations. You should take rest as far as it is possible else you may get drained. Routine or recurring expenses may need to be curbed in order to keep your finances streamlined. Ganesha feels that this is not at all the right day to invest money in any good looking schemes. Today you are in a mood to start working on new projects, foresees Ganesha. Therefore, you will do your level best and put in lots of efforts in order to finish old projects. Your energetic and hard working spirits are expected to ensure good results.

Get ready to bask in applause. Well, not literally, but Ganesha does foresee you getting that long due recognition today for all the hard work you’ve put at your workplace. This goes hand-in-hand with the support of your colleagues and the good wishes of your seniors, especially if it is some new project that you are undertaking. Remember, a job well begun is already half done. So carry on with the same zeal and watch success come your way, says Ganesha. Lucky Colour Light Bright Yellow Love life will be awesome. Surprises are on the cards. However, you should not expect more. Committed couples should remain happy. Singles will get the chance to fall in love, foresees Ganesha. It’s the right time to get married, feels Ganesha. Overall, a great time will come your way. Your health is going to be very good today, says Ganesha. You should do more exercise today to build your body and mind both. You should avoid over-eating. Having more fruits too will be very good. Make the most out of this day. Ganesha suggests you to avoid overspending today, as planetary positions are pointing towards huge expenses. If you wish to try your luck in another job or business, the day is favourable. Professionally a successful day is on the cards, feels Ganesha. You will succeed in getting work done from your staff. Your hard work will receive a lot of appreciation from your senior authorities. You will start thinking of taking up the new assignments.

A single-headed mission to be the master of your destiny will drive you ahead. Your management skills will be immaculate, and the fire to succeed will get you up and running. Your skill in the managerial post will be accentuated by your quick decision-making and superior analytical ability, says Ganesha. The long-term family planning will give you concern, foresees Ganesha. You may share the same thoughts with your loved one. It’s better to come up with effective solutions, suggests Ganesha. You need to understand your sweetheart and fill his/her heart with sweet words. You will require lot of rest today. Basically, your mind needs relaxation. Don’t apply too much logic to things. If you can’t take leave today or if you can’t leave office little early, at least listen to music to keep your strained nerves relaxed. This is ideal day to buy a new home-theater or TV which will add more value to your life and routine because you can enjoy movies or TV shows at home, with all the family members. You should take your career very seriously today. You need to understand the cause benefit analysis. Thinking pros and cons will help you decide confidently. It’s better to chalk out the plans and strategies accordingly to reach your goal, suggests Ganesha.

Ganesha says that you shall be immersed in successfully completing all your remaining work today. Whatever work you undertake today you shall be able to do it to your best capability and successfully and your work ability will be praiseworthy. Ganesha showers his blessings on you. A distinct probability of arguments will keep your relationship tensed. If you are in a long distance relationship, it’s time to make a call and express your love just to reassure your beloved, suggests Ganesha. You will have a high chance of developing a beautiful relationship, foresees Ganesha. You will be in good health today. You will be full of enthusiasm. You may face some rapid activities but that is not going to make you tired, feels Ganesha. It’s a good day also to enjoy outings. Activities will add to your energy. Some amount may be spent behind communication. This is by the way, a good day to spend money on new mobile or Tablet. Communication is the key to success, so investments done in that area should be worth. You tend to be inclined to people sharing similar interests with you. You need to enhance your memory power so as to solve complex problems effectively, suggests Ganesha. Important projects will get solved on time. You may express your views in the meeting.

Friends in influential positions will be of much help today. You may plunge into a new business venture without much ado. Appreciation for your abilities and efforts will fly in thick and fast. Your reputation is sky-rocketing among the opposite sex. Your commitment will ultimately find success in love life. You do not need to hide your current relationship status. It’s the time to let your family know if you are in a serious relationship, suggests Ganesha. If romance falls short of your expectation, you will spice up your romance. You should avoid confronting others. It may eat up much of your energy unnecessarily, says Ganesha. If others do not believe what you are saying, let it be. Don’t try to change it. You should remain calm to maintain good health. Family members will find a boost in their regular income. Ganesha feels that if you remain united with your family, you as a family will enrich further. Stay in tune with family members and see the results. You will be looking at life from a different angle, as a desire for profit rules your mind today. You will be determined to achieve positive results. It will be routine work at the office without any obstacles, says Ganesha. You want to make sure that your office will get benefitted from your contribution.

Dressed to kill – this phrase is enough to describe you today, says Ganesha. Decked up from head to toe in chic attire and classy jewellery, you make a bold statement. Like a magnet, you will attract attention at a party. Don’t get surprised if your list of admirers becomes longer. It is an encouraging day on the personal front and you can expect a gift from your partner. You will get the emotional support from your partner. This is a lovely day if you are planning on enjoying genuine pleasure in making simple things extraordinary. It’ s a good day for you. Your sportsman-spirit will help you win many hearts. You will be at the best of your wit. You will feel and seem more relaxed and at ease. Ganesha feels that the day is going to pass very swiftly. Because your buying impulse is going to be very high today, you may end up spending money on credit cards. You may also take loans to buy things. Well, Ganesha wants to warn you against such expenses today. You will get rewarded for your hard work from your boss. You may want to spruce up and look presentable. You will be able to express your opinions honestly in the meeting. You need to avoid overdoing this as people may get the wrong impression.

If wasteful expenditure has left your bank balance a tad below what you had anticipated, you will have reasons to rejoice today, says Ganesha. Cash inflow — and a substantial amount of it — is likely and will make you feel nice about your finances. Work will go on as usual. The only change may be a discernible change in the work ambience; it may get a little more comfortable. You may have the let go attitude today, foresees Ganesha. This will help you keep your emotional high tides in control. You may be busy in enjoying entertaining activities with your sweetheart. The relationship will go smoothly provided that you will talk sweetly with your partner. Today, you may need more privacy to think deeply about certain matters. Your mood will not be very good so ensure that in seclusion, you don’t start thinking negatively. Ganesha feels that you should avoid over-thinking and must socialize today to return to normal mood. This is ideal time to invest money in some spiritual course. If you learn to meditate or if you join some cult, it will help you go deeper within. This will teach you the value of life. Routine work may seem bored and intellectual stress will keep you worried, feels Ganesha. Decisions that you may take today will be practical but would not be the final solutions to problems. You are likely to finish off pending activities, feels Ganesha.

Lady Luck gazes lovingly upon you today! Bosses are pleased, colleagues are happy, and this makes work seem like leisure. You may want to get in touch with old friends who have moved far away. What are you waiting for, asks Ganesha, in this age of communication?. You need to think seriously about your relationship. You may have to give your partner his or her space. Compromise with your partner will be the challenge. However, a better understanding between the two of you will keep you safe, suggests Ganesha. Sharing is important today. That is going to double the joy and fun. As you will be in a cheerful mood, Ganesha is not worried about anything else. On the whole, it’s a good day from health point of view. Think about money that you have on hand and then decide if you can afford to spend or not. If you meditate over the matter, it will be waste of time. Face the reality, take decision and move on! Achieving your goal will be the prime focus today. Your out-of-the-box thinking is expected to bring a fresh approach today. You will be in the mood of breaking new grounds. This will definitely enhance your value at work, feels Ganesha.

A good day for those looking for romantic liaisons, says Ganesha. You will seek the company of your sweetheart to fight feelings of solitude and boredom today. Those who are single ought to strike gold, considering how Lady Luck will be grinning at the efforts you make to win over your love. An emotion filled day is on the cards foresees Ganesha. Your beloved will try his/her best to keep you in a good mood. With your partner, you may share your confusions and feelings which may help you take the right decision. Today your energy is going up and up so you should rather channelize it and use in proper direction, says Ganesha. You will remain focussed on your professional targets. The day looks very good. You may work for longer hours but won’t be tired. This is good time to talk about promotion or career change for better financial prospects. Stars are in your favour to build strong foundation of future finances. You should think about your career seriously now. It appears to be a lucky day for an interview. It’s also a good time to change your career. However, you should be very confident while making the ultimate choice. Take your decisions before it’s too late.
